verdict.rationale: Segment's docs pages show "Open in ChatGPT / Claude / Cursor / Perplexity" buttons, which hand a docs page to an AI tool. A downloadable OpenAPI spec for the Public API also gives agents machine-readable reference material. However, the probes found no llms.txt at the site root and no markdown rendering of the docs (both HTTP 404), so an agent cannot simply be pointed at a standard agent-oriented docs entry point. Missing for 10: a working llms.txt (or llms-full.txt), markdown/plain-text docs endpoints, documented agent-oriented docs guidance, and independent corroboration that agents can consume the docs.
